title: GTA6: Rockstar Researched Florida With Gang Members and Cops
description: According to IGN Games, Rockstar discussed traveling across Florida with gang members and cops for GTA 6 research, plus hovering above a Beyonce concert.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6: Rockstar's Extensive Florida Research Involved Gangs, Cops, and Helicopters

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the next chapter in the blockbuster franchise, new details regarding the development process of *GTA 6* have emerged. According to a report by IGN Games, Rockstar has discussed traveling extensively across Florida as part of its research for the game, going so far as to interact with local gang members and law enforcement officers.

### Pursuing Unprecedented Realism Through Fieldwork

Rockstar Games has long been celebrated for its commitment to environmental storytelling and atmospheric authenticity. To build the fictional state of Leonida—heavily inspired by Florida—the development team seemingly went to great lengths to understand the region firsthand. By engaging with both real-world gang members and cops during their travels across Florida, the studio likely gathered crucial contextual insights into the local criminal ecosystem, law enforcement dynamics, and subcultures that define the area.

This kind of immersive, ground-level research has historically been a cornerstone of Rockstar's development philosophy, ensuring that their satirical yet grounded depictions of American culture resonate with players.

### Aerial Perspectives and Unexpected Encounters

The research efforts weren't limited to the streets. The report also highlights that Rockstar personnel hovered in a helicopter above a Beyonce concert during their time in Florida. While the specific objectives of this aerial surveillance remain brief in the source material, it underscores the meticulous lengths to which developers go to study crowd control, urban lighting, and large-scale public events from a bird's-eye view.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's dedication to field research highlights why their open-world environments feel so remarkably alive. While interacting with local gangs and hovering over concerts might sound unorthodox, it is precisely this obsessive attention to detail that sets *GTA 6* apart in the industry. These behind-the-scenes insights only amplify anticipation for how these real-world observations will translate into the final game.
